verses.1:
Hallelujah! + 135:1 Or Hallelu YAH , meaning Praise the LORD ; also in verses 3 and 21 
 Praise the name of the LORD.
 Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
verses.2:
who stand in the house of the LORD,
 in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.3:
Hallelujah, for the LORD is good;
 sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
verses.4:
For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own,
 Israel as His treasured possession.
verses.5:
For I know that the LORD is great;
 our Lord is above all gods.
verses.6:
The LORD does all that pleases Him
 in the heavens and on the earth,
 in the seas and in all their depths.
verses.7:
He causes the clouds to rise
 from the ends of the earth.
 He generates the lightning with the rain
 and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
verses.8:
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt,
 of both man and beast.
verses.9:
He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt,
 against Pharaoh and all his servants.
verses.10:
He struck down many nations
 and slaughtered mighty kings:
verses.11:
Sihon king of the Amorites,
 Og king of Bashan,
 and all the kings of Canaan.
verses.12:
He gave their land as an inheritance,
 as a heritage to His people Israel.
verses.13:
Your name, O LORD, endures forever,
 Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
verses.14:
For the LORD will vindicate His people + 135:14 Or will judge His people ; see also LXX; cited in Hebrews 10:30|HEB 10:30 . 
 and will have compassion on His servants.
verses.15:
The idols of the nations are silver and gold,
 made by the hands of men.
verses.16:
They have mouths, but cannot speak;
 they have eyes, but cannot see;
verses.17:
they have ears, but cannot hear;
 nor is there breath in their mouths.
verses.18:
Those who make them become like them,
 as do all who trust in them.
verses.19:
O house of Israel, bless the LORD;
 O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
verses.20:
O house of Levi, bless the LORD;
 you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
verses.21:
Blessed be the LORD from Zion —
 He who dwells in Jerusalem.
 Hallelujah!

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
